text:
Priya (curation): quick pulse — we want to ship the catalog slice with nova-lite and compass2b next week. owners, call out any blockers (licensing, perf, infra).
Marco (runtime): nova-lite perf looks ok on bench but we only tested up to 512 tokens. p50=45ms p95=180ms on a T4 pool. need quant profile for cpu fallback.
Evan (legal): compass2b license is MIT-compatible but dependency `fasttoken` has a CLA question. filing ticket LEG-472. no blocker for nova-lite.
Lynn (mlinfra): embedding shape for compass2b is [1, 1536] not [1, 1024]. ingestion pipeline needs a small migration. estimate 2 days if prioritized.
Sam (platform): rollout plan: canary 5% then 25% over 24h. we need model tags + manifest in repo and a canary healthcheck (latency + error rate). who owns the healthcheck?
Priya (curation): i'll own the manifest. pushing PR now. please review: https://git.internal/r/redwood/catalog/compare/PR-789
Marco (runtime): tagging @Lynn for embedding shape. i'll open PR for quant profile + bench output. cc @Sam for healthcheck spec.
Lynn (mlinfra): noted. embedding migration work: update ingest transform and shape tests. i'll post a brief runbook.
Evan (legal): LEG-472 assigned to me. if `fasttoken` CLA not resolvable, fallback option is compass2b-lite (same weights, removed tokeniser dep).
Priya (curation): manifest snippet (adding to PR):
```
models:
  - id: compass2b
    owner: "Priya"
    license: "MIT (pending fasttoken CLA)"
    perf_profile: "compass2b-v1.json"
    embedding_shape: "1x1536"
  - id: nova-lite
    owner: "Marco"
    license: "Apache-2.0"
    perf_profile: "nova-lite-v1.json"
    embedding_shape: "1x1024"
```
Marco (runtime): quick ask — can someone run a small smoke with `--max-tokens 512` against nova-lite after PR merges? i can do the quant bench but need the smoke for canary baseline.
Sam (platform): i can run smoke in staging today 4pm PT. @Marco send the exact command.
Marco (runtime): `redwoodctl model test --model nova-lite --payload tests/smoke/512.json --report=perf.json`
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: catalog-service @ 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z (canary first).
Priya (curation): action items: 1) Evan -> resolve LEG-472 or produce compass2b-lite fallback (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Marco -> PR for quant profile + bench (due tomorrow). 3) Lynn -> post ingest runbook + ETA (end of day). 4) Sam -> healthcheck spec + run smoke at 4pm PT. i will merge manifest PR after quick reviews.
Lynn (mlinfra): ack, will share runbook by EOD.
Evan (legal): ack, i'll update LEG-472 by EOD with next steps.
Marco (runtime): ack, aiming to finish bench PR by EOD.
Sam (platform): ack, will post healthcheck spec in PR comments and run smoke at 4pm. :thumbsup:
Priya (curation): thanks all — ping here if anything slips. closing loop in tomorrow's async sprint update.
